candidates.change_summary: Replace the line that sets acc.unlockTime to use the smaller of _unlockTime and block.timestamp (allows setting unlockTime in the past), changing unlocking behavior after Put.
Replace the line that updates acc.balance to instead set it to exactly msg.value (drops previous balance), altering subsequent observable balance after Put.
Insert a require that msg.value is at least MinSum, rejecting small deposits and thus changing observable Put success for those calls.
Replace the call to LogFile.AddMessage with no logging (remove it), altering observable logs and any on-chain History changes from Put.
Replace the require that checks for overflow with a no-op (remove require), allowing improbable overflow behavior to change balance after Put.
Change the withdrawal condition to require block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime (allowing collection at exact unlock time rather than strictly after).
Remove the check against MinSum so users can collect even if their balance is below MinSum.
Skip the balance decrement before external call (move decrement after the external call), affecting reentrancy behavior and observable balances after Collect.
Change the call to use transfer (throws on failure) instead of low-level call, altering failure handling and gas stipend.
Change condition to require acc.balance>_am (strictly greater) so Collect with exact balance equal to _am is rejected.
